newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEP LOWERS GASOLINE, UPS DIESEL PRICES THURS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEP LOWERS GASOLINE, UPS DIESEL PRICES THURS.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) said in a statement that gasoline prices will be lowered by 0.50 drachmas per litre but diesel prices will rise by 1.00 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday and for one week.

The price adjustments come after lower international gasoline prices, down by $1.4 per metric tonne, higher diesel prices, up by $4.8 per metric tonne and a softer dollar/drachma parity as the dollar slipped 0.9 drachmas, it said.
